summary: A council member asks whether a store can rely on its waiver if a later ordinance changes the rule.
realLife: Loveless asked about the exemption's future. Boeckmann advised that the applicant would have no vested right preventing a later council from changing it.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: waiver term and subsequent ordinance.

turns.what: The applicant asks the clerk for written confirmation of the end date.
turns.pulledBy: The later ordinance preserves existing waivers.
turns.writesBack: The clerk keeps the original end date.

turns.what: A cashier has to change how the till handles deposits.
turns.pulledBy: The later ordinance extinguishes the waiver.
turns.writesBack: The shop receives a new compliance date.
